lines.speaker: government
lines.text: I'm an operator of the Central Government's Intelligence Department.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: We have an urgent task for you.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: 42 hours ago, a Commander ran away to the surface.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: The Commander doesn't pose any danger as she's currently unarmed.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Since she's a Commander, any information about the Ark is at the risk of being leaked if a Rapture captures her.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Please get her back as soon as possible.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: I'm sending you the target's information and estimated coordinates.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: We'll be waiting for your good news.
... They didn't give me a choice. I'll go to the coordinates.
